name: astc8x8-srgb-to-u64-word-planes

output_layout.input_per_lane: two adjacent sampled pixels, each packUnorm4x8(texelFetch(ASTC))
output_layout.word_order: for tile t: words[t*64+0..31] are low32 by lane; words[t*64+32..63] are high32 by lane
output_layout.audit_rgba_order: one little-endian packed RGBA uint32 per pixel

synchronization.before: make ASTC image writes visible to compute shader reads; image in SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL
synchronization.after: make shader storage-buffer writes visible to the next GPU or host consumer; submit and signal using the caller's queue policy

verified_device: Galaxy S24 SM-S921N / Samsung Xclipse 940 / Vulkan 1.3.304
framework_status: independent Vulkan GPU kernel; no LiteRT or ENN delegate ABI
